title: Help I do not know how to code! Some backstory -
author: Starving-Fartist
selftext:
I have a game night group of friends, about a year ago I created a home brew tabletop game that my friends loved and it became a staple in our game nights. With the advancement of AI I thought it was about time to try to turn it into a digital game. I am using both Astra and opus to develop it. It has for the most part been decent and the game is mostly playable. I used ChatGPT image gen to create reference images and tripo to create the assets. The game is far from perfect and I’m at a point I’m having trouble making real headway with performance on the phone app. The ui still feels clunky in parts and the anima to on is really lacking. 

I’m looking for tips on how to better get my agents to polish up the features and make the game more stable.
